occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The documented annual training hours/certificates provided for review during the monitoring inspection on 06/26/23 for training period 08/06/21-08/06/22 did not include training on the following required topics in Health and Safety. 2. communicable diseases to  include immunizations 3. administering medication 4. preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction 5. building and physical premises safety and 6. handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.     As of 07/17/23, the training certificates have not been received.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Registered or Licensed Child-Care Home Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System, unless located in a School Facility: The carbon monoxide detector was not working; even with new batteries.  It had a manufacture date of February 2013 and recommended replacement 10 years after initial use.
